destiny.GetBoxCenter.note: The module-level Python function implements and tests both accepted legacy call shapes.

destiny.Ballpark.GetBoxCenter.note: The Ballpark wrapper and Rust handler implement the tested four-argument legacy partition-cell calculation.

destiny.Ball.speedFraction.note: The value is validated, mutable, replicated, and snapshotted; it has no steering effect because the corresponding Destiny controllers are intentionally unsupported.

destiny.Ballpark.SetSpeedFraction.note: The call updates validated replicated state only; it has no steering effect because the corresponding Destiny controllers are intentionally unsupported.

destiny.Ball.AddProximitySensor.note: Implemented by a bounded deterministic compatibility scheduler, not by an Avian Sensor collider or Avian collision events.

destiny.Ballpark.AddProximitySensor.note: Implemented by a bounded deterministic compatibility scheduler, not by an Avian Sensor collider or Avian collision events.

destiny.ClientBall.ApplyImpulsiveForceAt.note: The call updates nonreplicated presentation angular velocity and intentionally leaves authoritative Avian motion unchanged.

destiny.net.server.NetworkInterface.sing.note: The Rust bridge resolves an authenticated Carbon ID to one Lightyear link and sends one recipient-redacted ordered-reliable frame; product authentication remains host-owned.

destiny.net.server.NetworkInterface.narr.note: The Rust bridge resolves authenticated Carbon IDs to individual Lightyear links and redacts the other recipient IDs from each ordered-reliable frame; product authentication remains host-owned.
